about: INPUT to the served-wave-verify-v1 buoy freeze (gate section 3). The candidate pool, by region, written by hand BEFORE any station was probed or any forecast read: every active-looking NDBC wave station in each region the gate names, plus CDIP stations (exam only). `sheltered` names the feature a station sits inside or behind (the rule in served_wave_verify_freeze_buoys.SHELTER_RULE); absent = exposed. backend/scripts/served_wave_verify_probe_buoys.py probes each id (NDBC station page + realtime2) into the catalogue; backend/scripts/served_wave_verify_freeze_buoys.py selects from it by the gate's rules only. No skill enters.
